units.source_text: 到了傍晚，四位侍从薰君也来向玉鬘尚侍贺年。

en.t: Toward evening, Lord Kaoru, the chamberlain of the fourth rank, also came to offer New Year greetings to Tamakazura, the Naishi no Kami.

units.source_text: 昼间聚集在这邸内的许多显贵青年公子，个个相貌堂堂，可谓美玉无瑕。

en.t: Many noble young gentlemen had gathered at the residence during the day, and each was handsome and dignified, like flawless polished jade.

units.source_text: 然而最后来的这位四位侍从，特别惹人注目。

en.t: Yet this chamberlain of the fourth rank, who arrived last, drew people's eyes most of all.

units.source_text: 一向容易感动的青年侍女们都说：“到底与众不同啊！”

en.t: The young ladies-in-waiting, always quick to be moved, all said, "He really is different from the others."

units.source_text: 还说些刺耳的话：“教这位公子来做我家小姐的女婿，倒是很好的一对呢！”

en.t: They even said some rather cutting things: "If this gentleman were made our young lady's husband, they would make a very fine pair."

units.source_text: 这薰君的确长得肢体娇嫩，风度优雅。

en.t: Lord Kaoru was indeed delicately formed and graceful in bearing.

units.source_text: 一举一动，身上就散发一股香气，芬芳无匹。

en.t: With every movement, a fragrance rose from him, a scent of unmatched sweetness.

units.source_text: 即使是生长深闺的小姐，只要是知情识趣的人，

en.t: Even a young lady raised deep within the inner chambers, so long as she had taste and understanding,

units.source_text: 见了这薰君也一定会注目，赞叹他是超群出众的人。

en.t: would surely take notice of Lord Kaoru if she saw him, and praise him as a man who stood far above the rest.

units.source_text: 此时玉鬘尚侍正在念佛堂里，便吩咐侍女：“请他到这里来。”

en.t: At that moment Tamakazura, the Naishi no Kami, was in the hall for Buddhist devotions, and she told an attendant, "Please bring him here."

units.source_text: 薰君从东阶升入佛堂，在门口的帘前坐下。

en.t: Lord Kaoru ascended by the eastern steps into the Buddhist hall and sat down before the curtain at the doorway.

units.source_text: 佛堂窗前几株小梅树，正在含苞欲放。

en.t: Before the hall's window, several small plum trees were just about to open their buds.

units.source_text: 早春的莺声啭得尚未纯熟。

en.t: The song of the early spring warbler was still not fully practiced.

units.source_text: 众侍女希望这美男子在这美景中态度更风流些，便用种种戏言挑逗他。

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting hoped this beautiful man would behave more romantically amid such lovely scenery, and they teased him with all kinds of playful remarks.

units.source_text: 薰君却只管沉默寡言，正襟危坐，使得她们扫兴。

en.t: Lord Kaoru, however, remained quiet and reserved, sitting formally upright, which left them disappointed.

units.source_text: 有一个名叫宰相君的身份高贵的侍女便咏诗一首奉赠，诗曰：

en.t: A high-ranking lady-in-waiting named Saisho no Kimi then composed a poem and offered it to him. The poem said:
